title: Madou Monogatari
overview:
An RPG that's kind to everyone

A grand adventure in the world of Puyo Puyo. The hero Ragnus sets out to defeat Yoggus but fails, and Yoggus's curse sends him into Arle's world. Soon afterward, strange creatures called Yogs begin appearing all over the land. Arle, together with Rulue, Carbuncle and the friends she meets along the way, sets out to stop the Yogs.

Explore maze-like areas shown from an isometric viewpoint, solving light puzzles to open the way forward. Battles are viewed from the side, with the colorful cast moving lively on screen. Up to three companions can travel with you, while Carbuncle tags along and sometimes jumps into a fight on its own.

みんなに優しいRPG
